shortDescription: Corporate America’s strong earnings are supported by a robust economic outlook and the artificial intelligence boom, so worries about an “earnings bubble” are overblown, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc. strategist Snider, Bloomberg reported.

title: Goldman Sachs Strategist Snider Dismisses US Earnings Bubble Fears
